name: SwitchPorts — Native Ports, Emulators & Homebrew
description: Community-made native Switch ports, standalone emulators, applications and utilities. Direct NRO assets are pinned with verified release sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Original games, ROMs, BIOS and supporting files are not included; follow each developer's setup instructions.
